assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Painted fantasy RPG encyclopedia illustration, rich atmospheric brushwork, exquisite aged materials, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no people. Decorative atmosphere rather than canonical geography. Asset: portrait 9:16 background for a narrow navigation drawer for Kuroto, an oriental fantasy campaign. Weathered cedar shrine wood and elegant black bamboo along edges, a single antique vermilion hanging lantern low on the right, faint gilt ornament and drifting plum-colored mist, mossy stone at bottom. Ink black, smoky plum, restrained vermilion and antique gold. Broad quiet dark central vertical space for overlaid navigation. Intimate material-rich composition, no castle, no torii, no text or characters. Full bleed vertical artwork.
